Strait of Hormuz traffic has dropped sharply (6 vessels vs. a 13-vessel 10-day average), signaling real supply disruption risk. Global oil inventories are already declining. Iran is expanding vessel blacklists in the Strait. Iraq is ramping exports under Iranian-approved tanker arrangements. Higher oil prices are feeding inflation expectations, driving increased bets on a Fed rate hike.
